payload.title: Anth.us-Papyrus: keep shared link previews working (old Gatsby /static/ og:image URLs)
payload.description: Live Gatsby pages set og:image/twitter:image to https://anth.us/static/<hash>/<hash>/<file>. Every link already shared on social media embeds those URLs, and they will 404 after cutover, so existing previews lose their images. Minimal fix (YAGNI): for each article, read the og:image URL from the verified production build (/Users/home/Projects/Anth.us-live/public/**/index.html), map it to the port's corresponding image file, and emit an Amplify 301 rule from the old /static/... path to the new image URL (generated by web/anthus_urls.py alongside the legacy page rules, before the 404 catch-all). Only og:image/twitter:image URLs; not every /static/ rendition. Verify a handful live after deploy.
